root: ^MACHA CAREFUL DA! THAT'S A TEACHER! IF HE SEES YOU, HE'LL TRY TO CATCH YOU!
^THEY CAN'T SEE YOU IF YOU'RE UNDER A TABLE, BUT IF THEY SEE YOU CRAWLING UNDER ONE, THEY CAN CROUCH TO LOOK UNDERNEATH.
^IF YOU CRAWL, YOU MOVE MORE SLOWLY, BUT IT'LL BE HARDER FOR THEM TO SEE YOU.
^THEY CAN EVEN HEAR YOUR FOOTSTEPS IF YOU'RE VERY CLOSE, BUT THEY CAN'T HEAR YOU IF YOU'RE CRAWLING.
